newsitem.title: USA: Capitol Hill lawyer named counsel to SEC chief.
newsitem.headline: Capitol Hill lawyer named counsel to SEC chief.

text.p: Timothy Forde, minority counsel for the House Commerce Committee, was named counsel to Securities and Exchange Commission Chairman Arthur Levitt, the agency announced on Tuesday.
Forde, 39, is credited with helping develop compromises that led to the passage of a federal law earlier this year that minimized overlaps in state and federal securities regulation.
He has been minority counsel to the Commerce Committee since 1995. Before that, he was senior counsel to the House Telecommunications and Finance subcomittee from 1992 to 1995.
Prior to working on Capitol Hill, he was an associate at the New York-based Davis Polk and Wardwell law offices.
